description.zh: 滚动超过阈值后出现在右下角，点击回到页面或指定容器的顶部。
description.en: Appears in the bottom-right corner after scrolling past a threshold and returns the page or a chosen container to the top.

description.zh: 触发一个操作，支持变体、语义色调、尺寸与加载态。
description.en: Triggers an action; supports variants, semantic tones, sizes and a loading state.

description.zh: 分组承载相关内容的纯布局容器，自带边框 / 阴影 / 填充三种外观。
description.en: A layout-only container for grouping related content, with border, shadow and filled looks.

description.zh: 基于 CSS Grid 的 24 栏栅格行，配合 Col 完成列间距、偏移、排序与响应式排版。
description.en: A 24-column CSS Grid row that, together with Col, handles gutter, offset, order and responsive layout.

description.zh: 对内容进行分类或标记，支持语义色调、多种变体与可关闭交互。
description.en: Labels and categorises content, with semantic tones, variants and dismissible interaction.

description.zh: 表单组合层：负责布局与提交编排，FormItem 提供标签、提示与错误的可访问性关联。
description.en: Form composition layer for layout and submit orchestration; FormItem wires labels, hints and errors accessibly.

description.zh: 接收用户的单行文本输入。
description.en: Accepts a single line of text input.

description.zh: 录入一次性验证码：逐格输入、粘贴分发，并在填满后抛出完成事件。
description.en: Captures a one-time code with one cell per character, paste distribution and a complete event.

description.zh: 切换单个选项的开启 / 关闭状态。
description.en: Toggles a single option on or off.

description.zh: 录入多个自由文本标签，支持回车 / 分隔符提交、粘贴拆分与数量 / 去重约束。
description.en: Enters multiple free-text tags with Enter or delimiter commit, paste splitting and count / duplicate limits.

description.zh: 在候选集与已选集之间移动条目，支持搜索与禁用。
description.en: Moves items between a source and a target list, with search and disabled states.

description.zh: 从多级树形选项中选择一条完整路径，支持逐级展开与清除。
description.en: Selects a full path from a multi-level option tree, with step-by-step expansion and clearing.

description.zh: 由触发按钮与日历面板组合，选中后按 dateFormat 展示日期。
description.en: Pairs a trigger button with a calendar panel and renders the picked date with dateFormat.

description.zh: 录入一天内的时间：时分（可含秒）、12 / 24 小时制、步进与时间区间约束。
description.en: Records a time of day with hours and minutes (optionally seconds), 12 / 24-hour cycles, stepping and time bounds.

description.zh: 从一组选项中选择单个值。
description.en: Selects a single value from a list of options.

description.zh: 在当前页面之上承载需要用户聚焦处理的内容。
description.en: Presents content that needs focused attention above the current page.

description.zh: 在当前页面内展示一条与上下文相关的反馈信息。
description.en: Shows a contextual feedback message inline on the page.

description.zh: 在触发按钮旁弹出轻量二次确认，支持危险语气与加载态。
description.en: Opens a lightweight confirmation next to its trigger, with a danger tone and loading state.

description.zh: 展示结构化数据，基于无头表格能力自建渲染，默认提供极简表样式与空态。
description.en: Renders structured data on a headless table engine with minimal default styling and an empty state.

description.zh: 以标签 / 内容成对展示只读字段，支持列数、跨列与带边框形态。
description.en: Shows read-only fields as label / value pairs, with columns, spanning and a bordered look.

description.zh: 展示确定的进度值或不确定的等待状态。
description.en: Shows determinate progress or an indeterminate waiting state.

description.zh: 承载操作或页面的最终结果，提供图标、说明与下一步操作。
description.en: Carries the final outcome of an action or page with an icon, description and next step.

description.zh: 按时间顺序展示事件，支持单侧 / 交替布局与语气色节点。
description.en: Presents events in time order with single-side / alternating layouts and tone-colored dots.

description.zh: 在一组同级内容间切换，同一时刻只展示一个面板。
description.en: Switches between sibling panels, showing one at a time.

description.zh: Markdown 富文本编辑器轻量封装：暗色与语言跟随宿主状态自动联动。
description.en: A lightweight Markdown editor wrapper whose theme and language follow the host state automatically.
